fixes.cause: Astra WINDUP/END entered the generic skill catalog, which does not contain MS-1101..1103.
fixes.change: Route lifecycle records to the dedicated Astra actor; strike alone owns animation and damage. Unknown generic skills still fail.
fixes.reproduction: before-apocalypse/browser.json: two actual menu/start entries fail with the reported undefined-skill error.

fixes.cause: The generic 2000ms playback deadline interrupted Astra siege/fortress and could interrupt longer Blue Gear casts.
fixes.change: Use a bounded 6000ms deadline for dedicated Astra/Blue Gear strike events, without adding a delay or altering animation speed.
fixes.reproduction: after-lifecycle/1440-APOCALYPSE-0.json: siege timeout remains after lifecycle-only fix.

fixes.cause: Zero second/third basic attacks exceed the generic 2000ms deadline.
fixes.change: Allow 6000ms for the eight Blue Gear actor basic attacks; ordinary cards retain 2000ms.
fixes.reproduction: mobile/390-V-976+V-701-APOCALYPSE-0.json: second basic times out before final fix.

performance.conditions: Windows Chrome headless, PC 1440x942 and touch 390x844 emulation. Actual main menu/start/result/reentry; local loopback and isolated PGlite APIs. Public static bytes via read-only proxy for post-release tests. H5 iframe host emulation. No physical mobile, installed Windows client or native ONE store app measurement.
performance.comparison: Same Astra + V-047 party, cold/warm local runs: ready 4389/2652ms before and 7363/2904ms after. Single trials; before fails early while after plays complete animations, so overall/frame samples differ. Concurrent host activity and sparse git asset serving affect timings. No speed improvement claimed.
performance.bottleneck: First entry asset/font responses around 0.6-0.7s and main-thread tasks up to 140ms; repeat avoids most initial loading. Fix removes premature timeout cancellation/recovery rather than changing intended cast durations. Shared GSAP clock reused; no new per-frame task/network polling.
performance.renderer: After matched runs actual Pixi prerender p50 16.7ms / p95 20.8ms, max 109.7/103.9ms, one >50ms sample each. RAF 4.2ms is browser callback cadence and is not game render FPS.
performance.exit: All passing combat runs: canvas/actors/loading/ticker zero; latest harness also checks both timeline sets zero. Nox polling/RAF/audio/buffers/canvases zero; pack reads after close zero.

productionReadOnly.note: SS stock was increased from 25 to 45 each by a separate explicitly authorized operation during this audit. This task only read the latest setting and stock/issue counts; it did not reset or change economy settings.

limitations: Browser battle API is isolated and the full server timeline is reduced to complete representative skill groups and basic forms. This checks playback/entry/reentry/damage application, not a claim of end-to-end live-account battles or balance results.

Initial historical checks included superseded pre-awakening Zero balance/skill expectations, exact old runtime suffix expectations and missing sparse fixtures. Current policy and new delivery checks pass. Initial harness invalid rank pairing and Hakuya presentation-ID assumptions were corrected; failed evidence is retained.
Nox fixture WebSocket/service-worker warnings and Pixi cache warning are preserved. No missing public assets or page exceptions in final combat coverage.
